decision_basis: Outcome-independent substantive adjudication of model-assisted screens plus original questionnaires, stored codebooks and direct baseline fields
primary_rule: Recognizable source-supported argument with closest bipolar baseline policy item and sufficiently resolved historical knowledge key
expanded_rule: Additional contextual argument or documented source ambiguity; includes primary rows when estimated
independence_limit: Earlier Denmark results known; coders disclosed aggregate codebook summaries. Parent/reviewer saw UK crime baseline attitude frequencies to resolve stored-code reversal. No new comparative knowledge outcome was inspected before initial adjudication.
late_source_correction: An initial comparison run completed without its outcomes being inspected while the independent reviewer identified the UK-EU full-integration versus current-membership mismatch. Replaced unite1 with closer-relations releu1, restricted item to expanded, and reran before inspecting comparative estimates.
decisions: UK crime uses stored codebook labels, reversing the printed questionnaire's response numbering.
AMR prevention key conflict retained only in expanded mapping.
NI declining intake uses shared-campus t1q11e; curriculum facts use pupil-travel t1q11f; religious identity is not substituted.
Australia direct approve1 excludes uncertain/leaning answers; generic republicanism is not substituted.
A1R ACA has separate policy and party constructs; no capital-gains party mapping.
Utility importance scales do not define a clean opposite position; remain unclassified pending defensible alternative.
Bulgaria crime 2002 legal-prohibition item is not Roma knowledge; missing Bulgaria 2007 Roma microdata is not substituted.
validation: Independent review confirmed original source_row plus source respondent IDs for all 16 selected studies without mismatches; no outcome tables consulted in review.
post_estimation_source_correction: Low Vermont accuracy triggered a targeted source audit. Original final report PDFp25 explicitly excluded efficiency-impact item as flawed. Downgraded to expanded/source-flawed sensitivity after outcome inspection; preserved key3 and all estimates. This is not a preregistered exclusion.
